title: Matte White Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Towel bar for bathroom use, 30 inches / 30-inch / 30in wall-mounted straight bar made from solid brass in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. Use as a towel bar, towel rack, or towel holder to hang and dry bath towels while saving space with a wall mount design. Concealed screw mounting hardware creates a clean, finished appearance; includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4"). Dimensions: 30 Inch length, 30 in center-to-center, 0.75 in bar diameter. Weight capacity: 10 lb. Traditional style hardware for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures. Available in multiple designer finish options and backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty. Part of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina bathroom accessories. Allied Brass Carolina Collection.
